body_neck_circumference_status: Design reference only, not a measurement or a socket diameter conversion.
policy: Uniformly scale the accepted v14 PRINT meshes, then enlarge only the neck seat, lower neck entrance and hook slot. No global smoothing, remeshing, face editing or crown reshaping.
parameter_limits: This subtractive builder requires neck seat and hook slot at least as large as the scaled v14 cavities. A smaller body interface needs a separately designed insert or local neck-platform reconstruction.
physical_fit: NOT TESTED: adjustable draft, no target body selected.
